#!/bin/bash

# fetch_file.sh - Download a file from a remote URL using curl

# Usage: ./fetch_file.sh <URL> [output_filename]
# If no output filename is provided, the script will use the basename of the URL

# Check if URL argument is provided
if [ -z "$1" ]; then
    echo "Error: No URL provided"
    echo "Usage: $0 <URL> [output_filename]"
    exit 1
fi

URL="$1"

# Determine output filename
if [ -z "$2" ]; then
    # If no output filename provided, extract from URL
    OUTPUT_FILE="$(basename \"$URL\")"
    
    # Handle URLs that don't have a filename (end with / or contain no path)
    if [[ "$OUTPUT_FILE" == "" ]] || [[ "$OUTPUT_FILE" == \"?*\" ]] || [[ "$OUTPUT_FILE" == \"#*\" ]]; then
        OUTPUT_FILE="downloaded_file"
    fi
else
    OUTPUT_FILE="$2" i

# Download the file using curl
echo "Downloading file from $URL..."
curl -L -o "$OUTPUT_FILE" "$URL"

# Check if download was successful
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Successfully downloaded file as $OUTPUT_FILE"
    exit 0
else
    echo "Failed to download file from $URL"
    exit 1
fi
